label_source: the one-line's label naming the utility's transformer: the service starts there (the gear it feeds is the service equipment)
kva_source: rule: not given on the one-line, so sized at the service equipment's rating (amps x volts, x 1.732 three-phase) rounded up to the next standard three-phase size (IEEE C57.12.00 ratings); the utility sizes its own transformer from the demand load, verify with the serving utility
outline_source: rule: typical outline (width x depth x height, inches) of a three-phase pad-mounted compartmental transformer up to that kVA (IEEE C57.12.34); the utility's own standard and the unit it sets govern
clearance_source: rule: set 10 ft out from the building, clear of its doors and windows (NEC 450.27 safeguards buildings and openings from an outdoor oil-filled transformer; utility standards commonly ask 10 ft from openings and combustible walls, 3 ft from a noncombustible wall) - verify with the serving utility and the site plan
pad_source: rule: a pad-mounted transformer stands on a concrete pad 6 in larger than the unit each side and 8 in thick, built by the electrical contractor to the utility's standard (the documents' pad notes and the utility's drawing govern)
service_entry_source: rule: an underground service comes up into the service equipment from below unless its submittal says otherwise
